header: WHAT THE EDITOR DOES TO TEXT PASTED INTO IT: its colour is dropped. Text copied from a web page, a chat window, a document or a PDF carries its own colour (often a pale grey on a dark theme); the editor used to keep it, so the body looked dimmed and was saved that way. Bold, italic, underline, paragraphs and line breaks of the pasted text stay; I let the toolbar's swatches alone put the colour on. This is pure (no DOM), so it can be tested on the server.

symbols.name: stripPastedColours
doc: Removes the `color` declaration from every style attribute of this HTML. I leave other declarations, such as background-color, because the saving code drops those anyway. An emptied style attribute goes.
